text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text:
Today, Академия Тайсен is filled with the
echoes
of high-pitched screaming. The
cause for all this?
Fuji Kiseki.

A long, long line winds around the
courtyard like
tangled yarn.

Thank you. I'll savor every bite of this
chocolate
you so kindly made for me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I-I hope you like it!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A

text_block_list.text: Okay! Next in line, please!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member

text_block_list.text:
I-I always go to your races, Fuji! I'm
cheering for
you!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll keep doing my best to
make it
worth it for you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: O-ooh!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
choice_data_list: (It must be tough being this popular.)

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки greets each of her fans with a
sincere
smile and charming
politeness—the line never
seems to get
any shorter.
At night...
Good evening, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness you're still here! I
wanted to
come see you at lunch, but I
was so busy.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I just thought you might've been
expecting
something from me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Keep this a secret from everyone, okay?
Happy
Valentine's Day.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Where'd it go?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I made some chocolate just for you, but
it's gone!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Could I have misplaced it at lunch? But
no, I still
had it just a moment ago...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки mutters to herself as she
frantically
turns all her pockets out, but
the chocolate in
question is nowhere to
be found.
Oh no, I must've lost it! I'm so sorry...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
No, it's n—wait! Can you check your
pockets too?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Please? Can you just check your right
pocket real
quick?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There's no way... I reach into my
pocket... and pull
out a beautifully
wrapped chocolate.

Hehe, I hope you didn't think that was
too sappy.
It's not Valentine's Day every
day, so I wanted to
surprise you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: No. Thank you. I look forward to our continued collaboration.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки takes out a gorgeous bouquet
of
flowers.

You're very welcome! Also... I have a
request.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
This might sound strange, but may I have
one of
these flowers?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why she wants one, but I see
no
reason to refuse.
Thank you! I'm just so hungry.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: She brings the bouquet to her lips...
And eats a small rose.
Mmm, that was delicious.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I love roses. The thorns can be painful to
eat
sometimes, but that only adds to the
texture.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My favorite are red roses. Their sweet
fruitiness
makes them extra tasty.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: What do you say? Want to try a bite?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She hands me the bouquet, and I hold it
dumbly,
unsure what to do.

Then, I notice the sweet smell of
caramel.

Hehe, have you finally noticed? They're
actually
made of sugar!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to tell they're fake
without getting
a real close look them.
Their colors and shapes
look just like the
real deal.

They're pretty well made if I do say so
myself. I
practiced making them just for
today.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give you a memorable
present. How'd
I do?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'll call it a success, then!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ahem!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"Roses are red, violets are blue, sugar is
sweet,
but not as sweet as you."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Here's to more sweet days together, my
dearest
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки and I spend an unforgettable

Valentine's Day together.

Фудзи Кисэки and I spend an unforgettable

Valentine's Day together.
